src:
id
grep '^student:' /etc/passwd
cut -d: -f1,3,7 /etc/passwd | head -n 3
ls -l /etc/passwd /etc/shadow
head -n 1 /etc/shadow
sudo -n true
out:
$ id
uid=30033(student) gid=30033(student) groups=30033(student)
$ grep '^student:' /etc/passwd
student:x:30033:30033::/home/student:/bin/bash
$ cut -d: -f1,3,7 /etc/passwd | head -n 3
root:0:/bin/bash
daemon:1:/usr/sbin/nologin
bin:2:/usr/sbin/nologin
$ ls -l /etc/passwd /etc/shadow
-rw-r--r-- 1 root root   3421 Oct 13 23:36 /etc/passwd
-rw-r----- 1 root shadow 1434 Oct 13 23:36 /etc/shadow
$ head -n 1 /etc/shadow
head: cannot open '/etc/shadow' for reading: Permission denied
$ sudo -n true
sudo: a password is required
